install_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

export HOME="${HOME:-/root}"
export USER="${USER:-root}"

echo "==> Installing Rust toolchain via rustup (https://rust-lang.org)"

if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
  apt-get update -y || true
  apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl build-essential pkg-config libssl-dev || \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl gcc g++ make pkg-config libssl-dev || true
elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  dnf -y install ca-certificates curl gcc gcc-c++ make pkgconf-pkg-config openssl-devel || true
fi

export CARGO_HOME="${CARGO_HOME:-/usr/local/cargo}"
export RUSTUP_HOME="${RUSTUP_HOME:-/usr/local/rustup}"
mkdir -p "$CARGO_HOME" "$RUSTUP_HOME"

if ! command -v rustup >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  curl --proto "=https" --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain stable --profile default --no-modify-path
fi

# shellcheck disable=SC1091
. "$CARGO_HOME/env"

rustup default stable
rustup component add rustfmt clippy || true

# System-wide PATH for all users
install -d -m 755 /etc/profile.d
cat >/etc/profile.d/rust.sh <<EOF
export CARGO_HOME=/usr/local/cargo
export RUSTUP_HOME=/usr/local/rustup
export PATH="\$CARGO_HOME/bin:\$PATH"
EOF
chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/rust.sh

# Symlink into /usr/local/bin for non-login shells
for bin in rustc cargo rustup rustfmt cargo-clippy; do
  if [ -x "$CARGO_HOME/bin/$bin" ]; then
    ln -sfn "$CARGO_HOME/bin/$bin" "/usr/local/bin/$bin"
  fi
done
# clippy binary name
if [ -x "$CARGO_HOME/bin/clippy-driver" ]; then
  ln -sfn "$CARGO_HOME/bin/cargo-clippy" /usr/local/bin/cargo-clippy 2>/dev/null || true
fi

export PATH="$CARGO_HOME/bin:$PATH"
echo "==> $(rustc --version)"
echo "==> $(cargo --version)"
echo "==> $(rustup --version | head -n1)"
echo "==> Rust installed (see https://rust-lang.org)"
uninstall_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
echo "==> Removing Rust toolchain (rustup)"
export CARGO_HOME="${CARGO_HOME:-/usr/local/cargo}"
export RUSTUP_HOME="${RUSTUP_HOME:-/usr/local/rustup}"
if [ -x "$CARGO_HOME/bin/rustup" ]; then
  "$CARGO_HOME/bin/rustup" self uninstall -y || true
fi
rm -rf /usr/local/cargo /usr/local/rustup "$HOME/.cargo" "$HOME/.rustup" 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f /etc/profile.d/rust.sh
for bin in rustc cargo rustup rustfmt cargo-clippy clippy-driver; do
  rm -f "/usr/local/bin/$bin"
done
echo "==> Rust removed"
upgrade_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
export HOME="${HOME:-/root}"
export CARGO_HOME="${CARGO_HOME:-/usr/local/cargo}"
export RUSTUP_HOME="${RUSTUP_HOME:-/usr/local/rustup}"
if [ ! -x "$CARGO_HOME/bin/rustup" ]; then
  echo "rustup missing — reinstalling"
  curl --proto "=https" --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain stable --profile default --no-modify-path
fi
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
. "$CARGO_HOME/env"
rustup self update || true
rustup update stable
rustup default stable
echo "==> $(rustc --version)"
